C-201 Natural gas compressor; E-201 Feed preheater; R-201 Primary reformer; C-202 Air compressor; R-202 Secondary reformer; E-202 Waste-heat boiler;

T-201 Carbon dioxide absorber; E-205 Lean/rich solvent exchanger; T-202 Solvent regenerator; E-206 Regenerator condenser; V-202 Reflux drum;
E-207 Regenerator reboiler; P-201 Lean solvent pump; R-205 Methanator; C-203/C-204 Synthesis gas compressors; E-208 Intercooler;
E-209 Synthesis feed preheater; R-206 Ammonia converter; E-210 Refrigeration cooler; V-203 Ammonia separator; C-205 Recycle compressor.
